title: Exactly twenty-one – every player for themselves
description:
Three to five players at one basket with one ball. Everyone plays for themselves. One player starts with a shot from the free-throw line (or further out), worth 2 points. The ball is live straight away: everyone battles for the rebound, and whoever gets it may finish from where the rebound was taken for 1 point. The others may defend.

After a make, the shooter takes the ball back out behind the free-throw line before the next attempt – the others may pressure there but not steal until the player has shot or started to dribble. On a miss, whoever wins the rebound takes over.

First to exactly 21 points wins. Going over 21 sends you back to 13. More than five players: start a second game at the other basket. Variation: three-point shots are worth 3.

coachingPoints.text: Box out after every shot – the rebound decides the game.
Finish quickly and strongly after the rebound, with your feet under you.
Keep track of the score – sometimes you need a 1-point finish to avoid going over.
Defend for real, but without fouling.

frames.note: A shoots from the free-throw line for 2 points. B and C take position for the rebound.
B grabs the rebound and finishes straight away near the basket for 1 point. C tries to disrupt.
B scored and takes the ball out behind the free-throw line before the next attempt. A and C get ready to defend.
